column6: Great neighbors that help each other out. Beautiful location. Working together to figure out how we live well together.
column7: Governance structure and decisions seem disorganized. I'd like to see more openness to big/new ideas, and not "we tried this x number of years ago and it didn't work." I really think we need another recycling day. I know we "should" be able to fit all of our recycling in there, but people just don't break it down correctly. Would it really be that expensive to get another recycling day?

column12: Current structure seems very top-down, like the board has all the power. Would like to see things flatten out and maybe that will happen as circles start to reinvigorate. I also don't know how sociocracy plays into our decision making. Sometimes it seems useful sometimes it doesn't, most of us don't know much about it (at least of newbies). I think we should really think about if this still feels relevant to us or not.
